name: Breakdown with complete replacement resources
title: Engine failure during scheduled service
description: The assigned vehicle cannot continue and passengers are waiting.
objective: Restore service with a capacity-safe replacement bus and driver.

name: Breakdown with an undersized replacement vehicle
title: Vehicle breakdown with a full passenger load
description: The only replacement vehicle has fewer seats than the affected passenger count.
objective: Find a safe replacement without leaving confirmed passengers behind.

name: Breakdown without an available replacement driver
title: Breakdown during peak service
description: A replacement bus exists but all alternate drivers are assigned.
objective: Assess whether the trip can be recovered safely.

name: Breakdown without a usable departure bay
title: Recovery departure blocked by bay closure
description: The affected bay and all alternatives are unavailable.
objective: Recover the service only if a safe departure point is available.

name: Delay requiring continuity and passenger assessment
title: Late inbound vehicle
description: The assigned resources remain usable but departure must move by fifteen minutes.
objective: Assess continuity and notify affected passengers.

name: Delay with no active passenger bookings
title: Minor dispatch delay
description: The trip can continue and currently has no active bookings.
objective: Confirm a safe revised departure time.

name: Breakdown with replacement resource conflict
title: Replacement driver scheduling conflict
description: The proposed driver is already assigned during the recovery window.
objective: Reject conflicting resources and find a safe recovery combination.

name: Route disruption requiring continuity assessment
title: Road closure on the scheduled corridor
description: Operations must assess continuity and passenger impact before changing service.
objective: Assess service continuity and passenger impact for the disruption.

name: Safety incident with verified replacement resources
title: Vehicle removed from service after safety report
description: The affected vehicle must not continue, but verified alternatives are available.
objective: Prepare a replacement service without reusing the affected resources.

name: Replacement vehicle becomes unavailable before approval
title: Replacement vehicle entered maintenance
description: The previously considered replacement is no longer maintenance-safe.
objective: Fail safely when the replacement vehicle is no longer available.
